title: The Great Assize
edition: Printed in the 1771 Works. Preached at the Assizes before Sir Edward Clive, in Saint Paul's Church, Bedford, on 10 March 1758.
blurb: Rendered in modern English, to be read and heard. Open the 1771 text under each part to check the claims and the scripture.
era_note: John Wesley lived from 1703 to 1791. This sermon is in his 1771 Works. He preached it at Bedford, before Sir Edward Clive, on 10 March 1758. It is an English sermon, not an ante-Nicene father.

text_history.method: Rendered in modern English. The 1771 panel is the text of the Works Wesley himself had printed in 1771. It is public domain.
text_history.identifiers: Sermon 15 in the 1771 Works. Romans 14:10. Bedford, 10 March 1758.
